title: Implement action_task unlock from exact approved proposal with no actuation

gates.name: action task unlock and no-actuation tests

verify: action_task creation requires active Plant, fresh ActorContext, PlantAccessGrant/role eligibility, valid `cleared_for_approval` SafetyGateDecision, approved exact Approval, source/evidence refs, and unchanged proposal context.
Rejected, expired, revoked, stale, mismatched, or unauthorized approval creates no action_task.
action_task records describe human-performed work only and do not call actuators, emit device commands, or imply automatic execution.
No automated actuation tool, command, external side effect, or device execution path exists.
evidence_required: negative tests for invalid approvals and changed proposal context
no automated actuation command/tool search and regression evidence
T3 human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note before closure
constraints: Human approval unlocks only human-performed action_task records.
No automated device execution, actuator command, pump/dosing/light control, or external side effect may be introduced.
action_task cannot be created before Safety Gate decision and Approval paths exist.
invariants: Physical-action advice requires fresh data, Safety Gate pass, authorized human approval, and task/action tracking.
NEVER make human approval authorize automated device execution in the MVP.
Approval is exact-proposal scoped and non-replayable.
verification_targets: action_task cannot be created without Safety Gate clearance and authorized human approval
Boss and eligible Engineer create human-performed action tasks only
